/* GENERATED FILE. Edit the generator that writes it, never this.
 *
 * module LugliEmergencyLights, never Base. Script bodies MERGE per field: a redefinition
 * overwrites only the keys it names and every key an earlier body set survives, so
 * two mods sharing Base.FlareGun do not override one another, they interleave into
 * one item. BetterContainers already ships compatibility lists naming
 * Base.FlareGun and Base.FlareCartridge from two other mods.
 *
 * THE LIT VARIANTS CARRY SwingAnim = Throw AND NO PhysicsObject, deliberately.
 * SwingAnim alone drives WeaponType.getWeaponType (a chain of SwingAnim string
 * compares, WeaponType.java:39-51), which sets the Weapon anim variable to
 * throwing and rangedWeapon true: the real vanilla throw animation and aiming, for
 * free. PhysicsObject is the separate key that makes CombatManager:638 call
 * Throw(), whose only non-exploding branch is Base.Ball, whose IsoBall.Fall()
 * emits a 600 tile world sound. 600 is byte-identical to a ringing house alarm and
 * three times a shotgun, and WorldSoundManager exposes no way to cancel it. So we
 * take the animation and place the item ourselves.
 *
 * No ActivatedItem key anywhere: isEmittingLight() is
 * canEmitLight() && (!canBeActivated() || isActivated()), so an item that CANNOT be
 * activated and has LightStrength > 0 emits unconditionally while held. That is
 * exactly the chem light semantic, and it means the player can never switch one off.
 */
module LugliEmergencyLights
{

    {
        Base
    }

    /* Flare gun. A real firearm to the engine, and three keys carry the whole design.
     *
     * MaxHitcount = 0 and Projectilecount = 0 make a gun that does no ballistic work
     * at all and exists purely to fire Events.OnWeaponSwingHitPoint, which is where
     * our Lua reads the aim and launches the flare. Vanilla's M203 is built the same
     * way.
     *
     * It is NOT tagged base:fakeweapon, and that is deliberate rather than an
     * oversight. Revolver_CapGun carries that tag and looks like the ideal harmless
     * gun template, but SwipeStatePlayer.java:281-292 returns before
     * attackCollisionCheck when the tag is present and ammo is loaded, so
     * OnWeaponSwingHitPoint never fires and the entire hook is dead.
     *
     * WeaponReloadType is a closed Java enum, so revolver it is: the break-open
     * animation, which is what a flare pistol does anyway. HaveChamber = false with
     * MaxAmmo = 1 puts canShoot on the ammo-count branch, which is correct for a
     * single-shot break action.
     *
     * SoundRadius 50 rather than the engine throw's 600. A flare gun should be heard;
     * it should not be a house alarm. The tunable version of this is a sandbox option.
     */
    item FlareGun
    {
        DisplayCategory = EmergencyLights,
        ItemType = base:weapon,
        SubCategory = Firearm,
        Weight = 0.50,
        Icon = LugliEL_FlareGun,
        WeaponSprite = LugliEmergencyLights.FlareGun,
        StaticModel = LugliEmergencyLights.FlareGun,
        AmmoType = lugli:flare_cartridge,
        WeaponReloadType = revolver,
        MaxAmmo = 1,
        HaveChamber = false,
        ManuallyRemoveSpentRounds = true,
        Ranged = true,
        IsAimedFirearm = false,
        SwingAnim = Handgun,
        RunAnim = Run_Weapon2,
        AttachmentType = HolsterSmall,
        Aimingtime = 20,
        Reloadtime = 30,
        RecoilDelay = 20,
        MinAngle = 0.96,
        MinSightRange = 2,
        MaxSightRange = 6.0,
        MaxRange = 10.0,
        MinRange = 0.61,
        MinDamage = 0.1,
        MaxDamage = 0.2,
        HitChance = 60,
        MaxHitcount = 0,
        Projectilecount = 0,
        DoorDamage = 0,
        KnockdownMod = 0.0,
        PushBackMod = 0.0,
        SplatNumber = 0,
        SplatBloodOnNoDeath = false,
        Swingtime = 0.6,
        MinimumSwingtime = 0.6,
        SwingAmountBeforeImpact = 0.0,
        UseEndurance = false,
        ConditionMax = 10,
        ConditionLowerChanceOneIn = 200,
        MetalValue = 30.0,
        SoundRadius = 50,
        SoundVolume = 20,
        SoundGain = 1.2,
        /* Vanilla M36 sounds, every one of them verified present in this build's
         * media/scripts/generated/sounds/weapons/sounds_firearm_m36.txt. A named
         * sound that does not exist fails silently and leaves the action mute. */
        EquipSound = M36Equip,
        UnequipSound = M36UnEquip,
        DropSound = M36Drop,
        BringToBearSound = M36BringToBear,
        AimReleaseSound = M36AimRelease,
        InsertAmmoSound = M36InsertAmmo,
        InsertAmmoStartSound = M36InsertAmmoStart,
        InsertAmmoStopSound = M36InsertAmmoStop,
        EjectAmmoSound = M36EjectAmmo,
        EjectAmmoStartSound = M36EjectAmmoStart,
        EjectAmmoStopSound = M36EjectAmmoStop,
        ClickSound = LugliEL_FlareGunDry,
        SwingSound = LugliEL_FlareGunShot,
        ImpactSound = null,
        Tags = base:firearm,
    }
}
